purpose: Represent legal procedures as navigable conditional graphs.
rules: A procedural path must preserve conditional branches rather than flattening them into prose.
Each procedural requirement must point to the authority establishing it.
Forms are linked to the procedural node they implement, not merely listed by topic.
Exceptions must remain visible in the main path.
A procedure graph may contain unresolved branches when the source corpus is incomplete.

example_seed.trigger: juvenile proceeding within the scope of Rule 5.630
